items.title: Skyworks Solutions Surges 10%, Qorvo Climbs 6% While Chip Stocks Fall: Is the Merger Finally Clearing?
items.summary: Skyworks and Qorvo are surging while the rest of the chip sector bleeds red, and the divergence points to something specific happening behind the scenes of their proposed merger. Here is what the market appears to be pricing in.

items.title: Skyworks Chair: It Will Be a While Before This Cycle Ends
items.summary: Chris King, Chairman of Skyworks Solutions, is introduced as a semiconductor industry veteran with more than 50 years of experience. The segment highlights her time at IBM, her role as the first female CEO of a chip company at AMI Semiconductor, and that company's later acquisition by Onsemi. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close."
